Sprawdzam teraz nie sam HTML, tylko źródło danych z firmware: czy API rzeczywiście wystawia pola dla DS i DHT11, czy panel ich tylko nie pokazuje. Jeśli rozjazd jest w nazwach pól, to naprawa będzie mała i lokalna.Mam już odpowiedź merytoryczną, ale chcę ją podeprzeć konkretnymi liniami z firmware, żeby było jasne: czujniki są czytane, tylko panel nie pokaże nic, jeśli nie idzie po API ESP. Dociągam teraz linie odczytu DS i DHT.Jedna rzecz do doprecyzowania: w kodzie są jeszcze stare nazwy typu `dht22`, więc sprawdzam, czy to tylko nazewnictwo, czy faktycznie zły typ sensora. To ważne, bo przy błędnym typie panel mógłby pokazywać `--` mimo poprawnego okablowania.Tak, firmware je czyta. DS18B20 są odczytywane w `firmware/src/main.cpp#L200`, a wynik trafia do  i `temp_aquarium` w API statusu w `firmware/src/main.cpp#L412` i `firmware/src/main.cpp#L413`. DHT11 jest inicjowany jako  na GPIO8 w `firmware/src/main.cpp#L134` i jego wilgotność trafia do `humidity` w `firmware/src/main.cpp#L218` oraz `firmware/src/main.cpp#L224`.

Jeśli w panelu widzisz `--`, to najczęściej nie oznacza braku odczytu, tylko brak odpowiedzi z `/api/status` albo otwarcie strony jako lokalnego pliku zamiast przez ESP. Sam frontend czyta dokładnie te pola w `firmware/data/index.html#L343` i `firmware/data/index.html#L348`.

Najprostszy test: wejdź przez adres ESP w przeglądarce i otwórz bezpośrednio `/api/status`. Jeśli chcesz, mogę teraz dopisać w HTML mały komunikat „brak połączenia z ESP / brak danych z API”, żeby od razu było widać, czy problem jest w czujniku czy w połączeniu z webserwerem.

Najpewniejsza droga to upload filesystemu w PlatformIO, zwykle jako Upload Filesystem Image albo przez komendę `pio run -t uploadfs` w folderze `firmware`. Potem dopiero odświeżasz panel na ESP.

_**Agent (copilot/auto)**_

Tak, tylko że tu są 2 osobne rzeczy. Sam upload firmware już zrobiłeś, ale stary HTML siedzi w SPIFFS, więc trzeba osobno wgrać pliki z folderu data.

Najprościej:
1. Otwórz folder [firmware](firmware).
2. W PlatformIO uruchom zadanie Upload Filesystem Image, albo komendę pio run --target uploadfs.
3. Potem wejdź ponownie na http://192.168.4.1/ i zrób twarde odświeżenie strony.

Jeśli chcesz to robić wiele razy, to za każdym razem:
1. Zmieniasz [firmware/data/index.html](firmware/data/index.html).

Teraz dokładam kartę w HTML. Szukam dokładnego miejsca, żeby nie zgadywać kontekstu. Wstawiam nową kartę "ESP System" zaraz po zamknięciu karty Status Systemu (po `</div>` zakrywającym `.item` z API):

Najpierw build, żeby sprawdzić czy  się kompiluje: Build SUCCESS, tylko stare deprecation warnings z ArduinoJson. Teraz wgrywam firmware i filesystem równolegle (najpierw firmware, potem uploadfs): Wszystko wgrane. Oto co dodałem:

**ESP32-S3 ma dostępne bez żadnych zewnętrznych czujników:**

| Co | Skąd | Nowe pole API |
|---|---|---|
| Wolna pamięć RAM |  | `esp_free_heap` |
| Całkowita RAM / użyta |  | `esp_total_heap` |
| Wolna PSRAM (2MB w N8R2) |  | `esp_free_psram` |
| **Temperatura wewnętrzna** układu |  | `esp_internal_temp` |
| Częstotliwość CPU |  | `esp_cpu_freq_mhz` |
| Liczba rdzeni |  | `esp_chip_cores` |

W panelu HTML pojawiła się nowa karta **"⚙️ ESP32 System"** — pole "Wolna pamięć RAM" **podświetla się na czerwono**, gdy spadnie poniżej 20 KB (sygnał problemów z pamięcią). Temperatura wewnętrzna to temperatura samego układu ESP, nie środowiska — przydatna do wykrycia przegrzania sterownika.

```
    ['panelView','wiringView','scheduleView'].forEach(id => {
      document.getElementById(id).classList.toggle('active', id === tabName + 'View');
    });
    ['tabPanelBtn','tabWiringBtn','tabScheduleBtn'].forEach((id, i) => {
      const names = ['panel','wiring','schedule'];
      document.getElementById(id).classList.toggle('active', names[i] === tabName);
    });
    if (tabName === 'schedule') loadSchedule();
  } oldString:  function showTab(tabName) {
    const panelView = document.getElementById('panelView');
    const wiringView = document.getElementById('wiringView');
    const panelBtn = document.getElementById('tabPanelBtn');
    const wiringBtn = document.getElementById('tabWiringBtn');

    const showPanel = tabName === 'panel';
    panelView.classList.toggle('active', showPanel);
    wiringView.classList.toggle('active', !showPanel);
    panelBtn.classList.toggle('active', showPanel);
    wiringBtn.classList.toggle('active', !showPanel);
  }] map[filePath:j:\inkubator\firmware\data\index.html newString:    document.getElementById('espCpu').textContent = data.esp_cpu_freq_mhz != null ? data.esp_cpu_freq_mhz + ' MHz / ' + (data.esp_chip_cores || '--') + ' rdzenie' : '--';

    // Tryby ręczne
    const hManual = data.heater_manual_mode;
    document.getElementById('heaterModeLabel').textContent = hManual ? 'RĘCZNY (' + (data.heater_manual_pct || 0).toFixed(0) + '%)' : 'AUTO';
    document.getElementById('heaterModeLabel').style.color = hManual ? '#e74c3c' : '#28a745';
    document.getElementById('btnHeaterAuto').classList.toggle('active-mode', !hManual);
    document.getElementById('btnHeaterSet').classList.toggle('active-mode', !!hManual);

    const dManual = data.diffuser_manual_mode;
    const dOn = data.diffuser_on;
    let dLabel = dManual ? ('RĘCZNY — ' + (data.diffuser_manual_state ? 'WŁĄCZONY' : 'WYŁĄCZONY')) : ('AUTO — ' + (dOn ? 'WŁ' : 'WYŁ'));
    document.getElementById('diffuserModeLabel').textContent = dLabel;
    document.getElementById('diffuserModeLabel').style.color = dManual ? '#e74c3c' : '#28a745';

    // Czas
    const now = new Date();
    document.getElementById('lastUpdate').textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString('pl-PL');
  }

  // Inicjalizacja
  showTab('panel');
  fetchData();
  setInterval(fetchData, 3000);

  // Slidery tac
  document.getElementById('movePwm0').addEventListener('input', function() {
    document.getElementById('pwmSpeed0Val').textContent = this.value;
  });
  document.getElementById('movePwm1').addEventListener('input', function() {
    document.getElementById('pwmSpeed1Val').textContent = this.value;
  });
  document.getElementById('heaterPwmSlider').addEventListener('input', function() {
    document.getElementById('heaterPwmVal').textContent = this.value;
  });

  async function moveTray(trayIdx, btnId, statusId) {
    const btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const duration = parseInt(document.getElementById('moveDuration' + trayIdx).value, 10);
    const pwm_speed = document.getElementById('movePwm' + trayIdx).value;

    btn.disabled = true;
    status.className = 'move-status';
    status.textContent = '⏳ Wysyłanie…';

    try {
      const resp = await fetch('/api/tray/move?tray=' + trayIdx + '&duration_ms=' + duration + '&pwm_speed=' + pwm_speed, { method: 'POST' });
      const data = await resp.json();
      if (data.ok) {
        status.className = 'move-status ok';
        status.textContent = '✅ Ruch uruchomiony (' + duration + ' ms)';
        setTimeout(() => { status.textContent = ''; }, duration + 2000);
      } else {
        status.className = 'move-status err';
        status.textContent = '❌ ' + (data.error || 'Błąd');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      status.className = 'move-status err';
      status.textContent = '❌ Błąd połączenia';
    } finally {
      setTimeout(() => { btn.disabled = false; }, 2000);
    }
  }

  async function setHeaterManual() {
    const pct = document.getElementById('heaterPwmSlider').value;
    const el = document.getElementById('heaterStatus');
    try {
      const r = await fetch('/api/heater/set?pct=' + pct, { method: 'POST' });
      const d = await r.json();
      el.className = 'move-status ' + (d.ok ? 'ok' : 'err');
      el.textContent = d.ok ? '✅ Ustawiono ' + pct + '%' : '❌ ' + (d.error || 'Błąd');
    } catch (e) { el.className = 'move-status err'; el.textContent = '❌ Błąd połączenia'; }
  }

  async function setHeaterAuto() {
    const el = document.getElementById('heaterStatus');
    try {
      const r = await fetch('/api/heater/set?auto=1', { method: 'POST' });
      const d = await r.json();
      el.className = 'move-status ' + (d.ok ? 'ok' : 'err');
      el.textContent = d.ok ? '✅ Tryb Auto' : '❌ Błąd';
    } catch (e) { el.className = 'move-status err'; el.textContent = '❌ Błąd'; }
  }

  async function setDiffuser(on) {
    const el = document.getElementById('diffuserStatus');
    try {
      const r = await fetch('/api/diffuser/set?on=' + on, { method: 'POST' });
      const d = await r.json();
      el.className = 'move-status ' + (d.ok ? 'ok' : 'err');
      el.textContent = d.ok ? (on ? '✅ WŁĄCZONY' : '✅ WYŁĄCZONY') : '❌ Błąd';
    } catch (e) { el.className = 'move-status err'; el.textContent = '❌ Błąd'; }
  }

  async function setDiffuserAuto() {
    const el = document.getElementById('diffuserStatus');
    try {
      const r = await fetch('/api/diffuser/set?auto=1', { method: 'POST' });
      const d = await r.json();
      el.className = 'move-status ' + (d.ok ? 'ok' : 'err');
      el.textContent = d.ok ? '✅ Tryb Auto' : '❌ Błąd';
    } catch (e) { el.className = 'move-status err'; el.textContent = '❌ Błąd'; }
  }

  let scheduleLoaded = '';
  async function loadSchedule() {
    const sp = document.getElementById('schedSpecies').value;
    if (sp === scheduleLoaded) return;
    scheduleLoaded = sp;
    const tbody = document.getElementById('schedTableBody');
    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center;padding:20px;">Wczytywanie…</td></tr>';
    try {
      const r = await fetch('/api/schedule?species=' + sp);
      const d = await r.json();
      tbody.innerHTML = '';
      (d.schedule || []).forEach(day => {
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        if (day.lockdown) tr.className = 'lockdown';
        else if (!day.turn) tr.className = 'turn-off';
        tr.innerHTML =
          '<td><b>' + day.day + '</b></td>' +
          '<td>' + day.temp_min + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + day.temp_max + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + day.humidity_min + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + day.humidity_max + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + (day.turn ? '✅' : '❌') + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + (day.lockdown ? '🔒 TAK' : '') + '</td>' +
          '<td class="note">' + (day.notes || '') + '</td>';
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
      });
    } catch (e) {
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" style="color:#dc3545;text-align:center;">Błąd wczytywania</td></tr>';
    }
  } oldString:    document.getElementById('espCpu').textContent = data.esp_cpu_freq_mhz != null ? data.esp_cpu_freq_mhz + ' MHz / ' + (data.esp_chip_cores || '--') + ' rdzenie' : '--';

    // Czas
    const now = new Date();
    document.getElementById('lastUpdate').textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString('pl-PL');
  }

  // Inicjalizacja
  showTab('panel');
  fetchData();
  setInterval(fetchData, 3000);

  async function moveTray() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('moveTrayBtn');
    const status = document.getElementById('moveStatus');
    const tray = document.getElementById('moveTrayIdx').value;
    const duration = parseInt(document.getElementById('moveDurationMs').value, 10);

    btn.disabled = true;
    status.className = 'move-status';
    status.textContent = '⏳ Wysyłanie…';

    try {
      const pwm_speed = document.getElementById('movePwmSpeed').value;
      const resp = await fetch('/api/tray/move?tray=' + tray + '&duration_ms=' + duration + '&pwm_speed=' + pwm_speed, { method: 'POST' });
      const data = await resp.json();
      if (data.ok) {
        status.className = 'move-status ok';
        status.textContent = '✅ Ruch uruchomiony (' + duration + ' ms)';
        setTimeout(() => { status.textContent = ''; }, duration + 2000);
      } else {
        status.className = 'move-status err';
        status.textContent = '❌ ' + (data.error || 'Błąd');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      status.className = 'move-status err';
      status.textContent = '❌ Błąd połączenia';
    } finally {
      setTimeout(() => { btn.disabled = false; }, 2000);
  
      // Update PWM speed display when slider moves
      document.getElementById('movePwmSpeed').addEventListener('input', function() {
        document.getElementById('pwmSpeedValue').textContent = this.value;
      });
    }
  }]]
```

| Tabela | Co zawiera |
|---|---|
| **Rezystory pull-up (3,3 V)** | 4,7 kΩ na DS18B20, 10 kΩ na DHT11, 4,7 kΩ na I2C BMP180 |
| **Rezystory ochronne GPIO** | 100 Ω w bramkę MOSFET, 10 kΩ pull-down bramki do GND (zapobiega niezamierzonemu włączeniu przy starcie) |
| **Diody ochronne** | 1N4007 flyback na cewkę każdego przekaźnika (tace, dyfuzor) |
| **Kondensatory** | 1000 µF + 100 nF na 12 V; 470 µF + 100 nF na 5 V; 10 µF + 100 nF przy VCC ESP; 100 nF lokalnie przy każdym DS18B20 |
| **Bezpieczniki** | 5 A lub 10 A na 12 V (zależnie od mocy grzałek), 3 A per kanał MOSFET, 1 A PTC na 5 V |

Na dole jest też **ściągawka** z wzorem na bezpiecznik (I = P ÷ 12 × 1,25), wskazówkami dotyczącymi pull-up przy większej liczbie czujników i zalecanymi typami MOSFET (IRLZ44N, IRF3205 — otwierają się pełnym stanem 3,3 V z GPIO ESP).

```
+
+// ── Obliczenie docelowej temperatury komory ───────────────────────────────
+void tray_get_chamber_temp(float& out_target_temp) {
+  float sum = 0.0f;
+  int count = 0;
+
+  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TRAYS; i++) {
+    TrayState& st = tray_states[i];
+    if (!st.active || !st.today) continue;
+    sum += st.target_temp;
+    count++;
+  }
+
+  // Fallback do ustawienia globalnego, gdy brak aktywnych tac.
+  if (count == 0) {
+    out_target_temp = configMgr.cfg.system.target_temp;
+    return;
+  }
+
+  out_target_temp = sum / (float)count;
+}
```

Co wdrożyłem:
1. Trwały zapis do EEPROM dla każdej tacy:
- flaga czy jest zapis,
- dzień inkubacji,
- godzina i minuta obrotu,
- elapsed ms (czas inkubacji).
2. Odtwarzanie tych danych po restarcie.
3. Zapis zdarzenia obrotu przy:
- automatycznym starcie obrotu,
- ręcznym ruchu tacy.
4. Pokazanie w panelu przy każdej tacy:
- Ostatni obrót: Dzień X, HH:MM
5. Dane są teraz w JSON z endpointu tac i używane przez UI.

- `firmware/include/tray_controller.h#L13`
- `firmware/src/main.cpp#L76`
- `firmware/data/index.html#L520`

Wgranie:
- firmware upload: SUCCESS
- SPIFFS uploadfs: SUCCESS

Ważna uwaga:
- To jest znacznik czasu inkubacji (Dzień + HH:MM w ramach cyklu), nie zegar ścienny, bo układ nie ma RTC/NTP.
- Po użyciu API Reset celowo czyszczę historię ostatnich obrotów, bo zaczyna się nowy cykl.

Nie udało mi się z tej stacji odpytać AP pod 192.168.4.1 (brak połączenia do AP), więc lokalnie nie potwierdziłem odpowiedzi HTTP po deployu, ale build i oba uploady przeszły poprawnie.

<!DOCTYPE html>

  :root {
    --bg:       #0f1117;
    --bg2:      #171a23;
    --bg3:      #1e2130;

  body {

  .topbar {

    gap: 12px;

    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 100;
  }
  .topbar-logo {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 13px;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    color: var(--accent);
  }
  .topbar-logo span { color: var(--muted); }
  .topbar-sep { width: 1px; height: 20px; background: var(--border); }
  .topbar-stat {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-family: var(--mono);
  }
  .topbar-stat strong { color: var(--text); font-size: 13px; }
  .topbar-stat .dot {
    width: 6px; height: 6px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--muted);
    animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .topbar-stat .dot.ok   { background: var(--green); }
  .topbar-stat .dot.warn { background: var(--yellow); }
  .topbar-stat .dot.err  { background: var(--hot); }
  @keyframes pulse { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:.4} }

  .topbar-right { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
  .badge {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  }
  .badge-info  { background: rgba(79,156,249,.15); color: var(--accent); border: 1px solid rgba(79,156,249,.25); }
  .badge-warn  { background: rgba(234,179,8,.15);  color: var(--yellow); border: 1px solid rgba(234,179,8,.25); }
  .badge-hot   { background: rgba(239,68,68,.15);  color: var(--hot);    border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.25); }
  .badge-ok    { background: rgba(34,197,94,.15);  color: var(--green);  border: 1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.25); }
  .badge-lock  { background: rgba(124,106,247,.15);color: var(--accent2);border: 1px solid rgba(124,106,247,.25); }

  .alarm-flash { animation: alarm 0.7s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  @keyframes alarm { from{background:rgba(239,68,68,.08)} to{background:rgba(239,68,68,.22)} }

  /* ── TABS ─────────────────────────────────────── */
  .tabs {
    display: flex;
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 8px 20px 0;
    background: var(--bg2);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .tab {
    padding: 7px 14px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--muted);
    border: none;
    background: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    transition: color .15s, border-color .15s;
  }
  .tab:hover { color: var(--text); }
  .tab.active { color: var(--accent); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); }

  /* ── LAYOUT ───────────────────────────────────── */
  .main { padding: 16px 20px; max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 12px; }
  .grid-2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2,1fr); gap: 12px; }
  .grid-auto { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px,1fr)); gap: 12px; }
  @media(max-width:900px) { .grid-3{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;} }
  @media(max-width:600px) { .grid-3,.grid-2{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }

  .section-label {
    font-family: var(--mono);

  }
  .section-label:first-child { margin-top: 0; }

  /* ── CARD ─────────────────────────────────────── */
  .card {
    background: var(--bg2);

    border-radius: var(--r2);
    padding: 14px;
    transition: border-color .2s;
  }

    font-size: 11px;

    text-transform: uppercase;

  .metric-big {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 38px;

    transition: color .3s;
  }
  .metric-big.hot  { color: var(--hot); }
  .metric-big.warn { color: var(--yellow); }

  .metric-unit {
    font-family: var(--mono);

  .metric-range {
    font-family: var(--mono);

  }

  /* ── GAUGE BAR ────────────────────────────────── */
  .gauge-wrap { margin: 8px 0 2px; }

    width: 100%;

    border-radius: 3px;
    overflow: visible;
    position: relative;
  }
  .gauge-fill {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 3px;
    transition: width .6s ease, background .3s;
  }
  .gauge-fill.heater { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--warm), var(--hot)); }
  .gauge-fill.humidity { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--cool), var(--accent)); }
  .gauge-fill.memory  { background: var(--accent2); }
  .gauge-marker {
    position: absolute;
    top: -3px;
    width: 2px;
    height: 12px;
    background: var(--muted);
    border-radius: 1px;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
  }
  .gauge-labels {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    color: var(--muted);
    margin-top: 3px;
  }

  /* ── HISTORY SPARKLINE ────────────────────────── */
  .spark-wrap { margin-top: 8px; }

  /* ── TRAY STATUS ──────────────────────────────── */
  .tray-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    width: 10px; height: 10px;

  .tray-indicator.on { background: var(--green); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--green); }
  .tray-indicator.moving { background: var(--yellow); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--yellow); animation: pulse 0.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .tray-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .tray-name { font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; }
  .tray-detail { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--mono); }
  .tray-status-text { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; }

  }
  .wire-table td {
    padding: 8px 10px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(42,46,64,.5);
    color: var(--text);
    vertical-align: top;
  }
  .wire-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
  .wire-table code {
    background: var(--bg3);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--accent);
    padding: 1px 6px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .wire-table td small { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); display: block; margin-top: 2px; }
  .wire-section { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); padding: 10px 10px 4px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; background: var(--bg3); }

  /* ── HISTORY AREA ─────────────────────────────── */
  .history-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; }
  .history-point {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    color: var(--muted);
    text-align: center;
  }
  .history-canvas { width: 100%; height: 64px; }

  /* ── ESP METRICS ──────────────────────────────── */
  .esp-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 6px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .esp-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .esp-key { color: var(--muted); }
  .esp-val { font-family: var(--mono); color: var(--text); }
  .esp-val.warn { color: var(--yellow); }
  .esp-val.danger { color: var(--hot); }

  /* ── TAB VIEWS ────────────────────────────────── */
  .view { display: none; }
  .view.active { display: block; }

  /* ── DIVIDER ──────────────────────────────────── */
  .divider { height: 1px; background: var(--border); margin: 14px 0; }

  /* ── COUNTDOWN ────────────────────────────────── */
  .countdown-label { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 2px; }
  .countdown-val {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 18px;
    color: var(--text);
  }
  .countdown-val.soon { color: var(--yellow); }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- TOP BAR -->
<header class="topbar">
  <div class="topbar-logo">INKU<span>BATOR</span></div>
  <div class="topbar-sep"></div>
  <div class="topbar-stat">
    <div class="dot ok" id="apiDot"></div>
    <span>API</span>
    <strong id="apiStatusTop">--</strong>
  </div>
  <div class="topbar-sep"></div>
  <div class="topbar-stat"><span>Uptime</span><strong id="uptimeTop">--:--:--</strong></div>
  <div class="topbar-right" id="topbarBadges"></div>
</header>

<!-- TABS -->
<nav class="tabs">
  <button class="tab active" onclick="showTab('panel')">Panel</button>
  <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('heaters')">Grzałki</button>
  <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('trays')">Tace</button>
  <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('schedule')">Harmonogram</button>
  <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('wiring')">Połączenia</button>
  <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('system')">System ESP</button>
</nav>

<!-- ═══════════════════ PANEL ════════════════════ -->
<div id="view-panel" class="view active main">

  <div class="section-label">Temperatura</div>
  <div class="grid-3">

    <!-- Komora jaj -->
    <div class="card" id="card-temp0">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-title">Komora jaj · DS18B20 #1</div>
        <span class="badge badge-info" id="badge-temp0">GPIO 6</span>
      </div>
      <div class="metric-big" id="disp-temp0">--<span class="metric-unit">°C</span></div>
      <div class="metric-sub">
        Cel: <span class="metric-range" id="disp-target">-- °C</span>
      </div>
      <div class="gauge-wrap">
        <div class="gauge-track">
          <div class="gauge-fill heater" id="gauge-temp0" style="width:0%"></div>
          <div class="gauge-marker" id="marker-target" style="left:50%"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="gauge-labels"><span>30°C</span><span>40°C</span><span>42°C</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="spark-wrap">
        <canvas class="history-canvas" id="spark-temp0"></canvas>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Akwarium -->
    <div class="card" id="card-temp1">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-title">Akwarium · DS18B20 #2</div>
        <span class="badge badge-info">GPIO 6</span>
      </div>
      <div class="metric-big" id="disp-temp1">--<span class="metric-unit">°C</span></div>
      <div class="metric-sub">Wspólna linia 1-Wire</div>
      <div class="gauge-wrap">
        <div class="gauge-track">
          <div class="gauge-fill heater" id="gauge-temp1" style="width:0%"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="gauge-labels"><span>30°C</span><span>37°C</span><span>42°C</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="spark-wrap">
        <canvas class="history-canvas" id="spark-temp1"></canvas>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Wilgotność -->
    <div class="card" id="card-hum">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-title">Wilgotność · DHT11</div>
        <span class="badge badge-info">GPIO 8</span>
      </div>
      <div class="metric-big" id="disp-hum">--<span class="metric-unit">%</span></div>
      <div class="metric-sub">
        Zakres: <span class="metric-range" id="disp-hum-range">-- – --%</span>
      </div>
      <div class="gauge-wrap">
        <div class="gauge-track">
          <div class="gauge-fill humidity" id="gauge-hum" style="width:0%"></div>
          <div class="gauge-marker" id="marker-hum-min" style="left:40%"></div>
          <div class="gauge-marker" id="marker-hum-max" style="left:70%"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="gauge-labels"><span>30%</span><span>60%</span><span>90%</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="spark-wrap">
        <canvas class="history-canvas" id="spark-hum"></canvas>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="section-label">Grzałki i dyfuzor</div>
  <div class="grid-2">

    <!-- PWM Grzałka 1 -->
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-title">Grzałka CH0 · GPIO 1</div>
        <div class="mode-pill auto" id="pill-h0">AUTO</div>
      </div>
      <div class="metric-big" id="disp-pwm0">--<span class="metric-unit">%</span></div>
      <div class="gauge-wrap">
        <div class="gauge-track">
          <div class="gauge-fill heater" id="gauge-pwm0" style="width:0%"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="gauge-labels"><span>0%</span><span>50%</span><span>100%</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- PWM Grzałka 2 -->
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-title">Grzałka CH1 · GPIO 2</div>
        <div class="mode-pill auto" id="pill-h1">AUTO</div>
      </div>
      <div class="metric-big" id="disp-pwm1">--<span class="metric-unit">%</span></div>
      <div class="gauge-wrap">
        <div class="gauge-track">
          <div class="gauge-fill heater" id="gauge-pwm1" style="width:0%"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="gauge-labels"><span>0%</span><span>50%</span><span>100%</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="section-label">Tace i dyfuzor</div>
  <div class="grid-3">

    <!-- Taca 1 -->
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-title">Taca 1 · GPIO 18</div>
        <span class="badge badge-info" id="badge-tray0-species">--</span>
      </div>
      <div class="tray-row">
        <div class="tray-indicator" id="ind-tray0"></div>
        <div class="tray-info">
          <div class="tray-name">Silnik tacy</div>
          <div class="tray-detail" id="det-tray0">Ostatni obrót: --</div>
        </div>
        <div class="tray-status-text off" id="txt-tray0">STOP</div>
      </div>
      <div class="divider"></div>
      <div class="metric-sub">Dzień inkubacji:</div>
      <div class="countdown-val" id="disp-day0">--</div>
    </div>

    <!-- Taca 2 -->
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-title">Taca 2 · GPIO 19</div>
        <span class="badge badge-info" id="badge-tray1-species">--</span>
      </div>
      <div class="tray-row">
        <div class="tray-indicator" id="ind-tray1"></div>
        <div class="tray-info">
          <div class="tray-name">Silnik tacy</div>
          <div class="tray-detail" id="det-tray1">Ostatni obrót: --</div>
        </div>
        <div class="tray-status-text off" id="txt-tray1">STOP</div>
      </div>
      <div class="divider"></div>
      <div class="metric-sub">Dzień inkubacji:</div>
      <div class="countdown-val" id="disp-day1">--</div>
    </div>

    <!-- Dyfuzor -->
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-title">Dyfuzor pary · GPIO 21</div>
        <div class="mode-pill auto" id="pill-diff">AUTO</div>
      </div>
      <div class="tray-row">
        <div class="tray-indicator" id="ind-diff"></div>
        <div class="tray-info">
          <div class="tray-name">2PH63091A</div>
          <div class="tray-detail">Nawilżacz ultradźwiękowy</div>
        </div>
        <div class="tray-status-text off" id="txt-diff">--</div>
      </div>
      <div class="btn-group">
        <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="setDiffuser(1)">Włącz</button>
        <button class="btn btn-ghost"   onclick="setDiffuser(0)">Wyłącz</button>
        <button class="btn btn-success" onclick="setDiffuserAuto()">Auto</button>
      </div>
      <div class="status-msg" id="st-diff"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ══════════════════ GRZAŁKI ═══════════════════ -->
<div id="view-heaters" class="view main">
  <div class="section-label">Sterowanie grzałkami — niezależne kanały</div>
  <div class="grid-2">

    <!-- CH0 -->
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-title">Grzałka 1 — Kanał CH0 · GPIO 1</div>
        <div class="mode-pill auto" id="pill2-h0">AUTO</div>
      </div>
      <div class="metric-big" id="disp2-pwm0">--<span class="metric-unit">%</span></div>
      <div class="gauge-wrap">
        <div class="gauge-track">
          <div class="gauge-fill heater" id="gauge2-pwm0" style="width:0%"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="gauge-labels"><span>0%</span><span>50%</span><span>100%</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="divider"></div>
      <div class="control-row">
        <div class="control-label">PWM (%)</div>
        <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="0" id="sl-h0" oninput="document.getElementById('sv-h0').textContent=this.value+'%'">
        <div class="slider-val" id="sv-h0">0%</div>
      </div>
      <div class="btn-group">
        <button class="btn btn-warn btn-full" onclick="setHeaterManual(0)">Ustaw ręcznie CH0</button>
      </div>
      <button class="btn btn-success btn-full" style="margin-top:4px;" onclick="setHeaterAuto(0)">↺ Przełącz na AUTO</button>
      <div class="status-msg" id="st-h0"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- CH1 -->
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-title">Grzałka 2 — Kanał CH1 · GPIO 2</div>
        <div class="mode-pill auto" id="pill2-h1">AUTO</div>
      </div>
      <div class="metric-big" id="disp2-pwm1">--<span class="metric-unit">%</span></div>
      <div class="gauge-wrap">
        <div class="gauge-track">
          <div class="gauge-fill heater" id="gauge2-pwm1" style="width:0%"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="gauge-labels"><span>0%</span><span>50%</span><span>100%</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="divider"></div>
      <div class="control-row">
        <div class="control-label">PWM (%)</div>
        <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="0" id="sl-h1" oninput="document.getElementById('sv-h1').textContent=this.value+'%'">
        <div class="slider-val" id="sv-h1">0%</div>
      </div>
      <div class="btn-group">
        <button class="btn btn-warn btn-full" onclick="setHeaterManual(1)">Ustaw ręcznie CH1</button>
      </div>
      <button class="btn btn-success btn-full" style="margin-top:4px;" onclick="setHeaterAuto(1)">↺ Przełącz na AUTO</button>
      <div class="status-msg" id="st-h1"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="section-label">Dyfuzor pary</div>
  <div class="grid-auto">
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-title">Dyfuzor · GPIO 21</div>
        <div class="mode-pill auto" id="pill3-diff">AUTO</div>
      </div>
      <div class="tray-row">
        <div class="tray-indicator" id="ind2-diff"></div>
        <div class="tray-info">
          <div class="tray-name">2PH63091A</div>
          <div class="tray-detail" id="txt2-diff">--</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="btn-group">
        <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="setDiffuser(1)">Włącz</button>
        <button class="btn btn-ghost"   onclick="setDiffuser(0)">Wyłącz</button>
        <button class="btn btn-success" onclick="setDiffuserAuto()">Auto</button>
      </div>
      <div class="status-msg" id="st2-diff"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ════════════════════ TACE ════════════════════ -->
<div id="view-trays" class="view main">
  <div class="section-label">Niezależne sterowanie tacami</div>
  <div class="grid-2">

    <!-- Taca 1 -->
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-title">Taca 1 · GPIO 18</div>
        <div class="tray-indicator" id="ind3-tray0" style="margin-left:auto;margin-right:0;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--border2);"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="tray-row">
        <div class="tray-info">
          <div class="tray-name">Gatunek</div>
        </div>
        <select id="species-tray0" style="max-width:160px;" onchange="updateSpeciesBadge(0)">
          <option value="CHICKEN">Kura (21 dni)</option>
          <option value="DUCK">Kaczka (28 dni)</option>
          <option value="GOOSE">Gęś (30 dni)</option>
          <option value="QUAIL">Przepiórka (17 dni)</option>
          <option value="GUINEA">Perliczka (26 dni)</option>
          <option value="PHEASANT">Bażant (24 dni)</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="control-row" style="margin-top:10px;">
        <div class="control-label">Dzień inkubacji</div>
        <input type="number" id="day-tray0" value="1" min="1" max="30" style="max-width:80px;">
        <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="setTrayDay(0)">Ustaw</button>
      </div>
      <div class="status-msg" id="st-day0"></div>
      <div class="divider"></div>
      <div class="control-row">
        <div class="control-label">Czas ruchu</div>
        <input type="number" id="dur-tray0" value="15000" min="500" max="120000" step="500" style="max-width:100px;">
        <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);">ms</div>
      </div>
      <div class="control-row">
        <div class="control-label">Prędkość PWM</div>
        <input type="range" min="0" max="255" value="102" id="spd-tray0" oninput="document.getElementById('sv-spd0').textContent=this.value">
        <div class="slider-val" id="sv-spd0">102</div>
      </div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary btn-full" id="movebtn-0" onclick="moveTray(0)">▶ Uruchom Tacę 1</button>
      <div class="status-msg" id="st-move0"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Taca 2 -->
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-title">Taca 2 · GPIO 19</div>
        <div class="tray-indicator" id="ind3-tray1" style="margin-left:auto;margin-right:0;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--border2);"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="tray-row">
        <div class="tray-info">
          <div class="tray-name">Gatunek</div>
        </div>
        <select id="species-tray1" style="max-width:160px;" onchange="updateSpeciesBadge(1)">
          <option value="CHICKEN">Kura (21 dni)</option>
          <option value="DUCK">Kaczka (28 dni)</option>
          <option value="GOOSE">Gęś (30 dni)</option>
          <option value="QUAIL">Przepiórka (17 dni)</option>
          <option value="GUINEA">Perliczka (26 dni)</option>
          <option value="PHEASANT">Bażant (24 dni)</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="control-row" style="margin-top:10px;">
        <div class="control-label">Dzień inkubacji</div>
        <input type="number" id="day-tray1" value="1" min="1" max="30" style="max-width:80px;">
        <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="setTrayDay(1)">Ustaw</button>
      </div>
      <div class="status-msg" id="st-day1"></div>
      <div class="divider"></div>
      <div class="control-row">
        <div class="control-label">Czas ruchu</div>
        <input type="number" id="dur-tray1" value="15000" min="500" max="120000" step="500" style="max-width:100px;">
        <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);">ms</div>
      </div>
      <div class="control-row">
        <div class="control-label">Prędkość PWM</div>
        <input type="range" min="0" max="255" value="102" id="spd-tray1" oninput="document.getElementById('sv-spd1').textContent=this.value">
        <div class="slider-val" id="sv-spd1">102</div>
      </div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary btn-full" id="movebtn-1" onclick="moveTray(1)">▶ Uruchom Tacę 2</button>
      <div class="status-msg" id="st-move1"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══════════════════ SCHEDULE ═════════════════ -->
<div id="view-schedule" class="view main">
  <div class="section-label">Harmonogram inkubacji — niezależny dla każdej tacy</div>
  <div class="grid-2">

    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-title">Taca 1</div>
        <select id="sched-species0" onchange="loadSchedule(0)" style="max-width:160px;font-size:11px;padding:4px 8px;">
          <option value="CHICKEN">Kura (21 dni)</option>
          <option value="DUCK">Kaczka (28 dni)</option>
          <option value="GOOSE">Gęś (30 dni)</option>
          <option value="QUAIL">Przepiórka (17 dni)</option>
          <option value="GUINEA">Perliczka (26 dni)</option>
          <option value="PHEASANT">Bażant (24 dni)</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div style="overflow-x:auto;max-height:500px;overflow-y:auto;">
        <table class="sched-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Dzień</th><th>Temp °C</th><th>Wilg %</th><th>Obrót</th><th>Lockdown</th><th>Uwagi</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody id="sched-body0"><tr><td colspan="6" style="color:var(--muted);text-align:center;padding:20px;">Ładowanie...</td></tr></tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-title">Taca 2</div>
        <select id="sched-species1" onchange="loadSchedule(1)" style="max-width:160px;font-size:11px;padding:4px 8px;">
          <option value="CHICKEN">Kura (21 dni)</option>
          <option value="DUCK">Kaczka (28 dni)</option>
          <option value="GOOSE">Gęś (30 dni)</option>
          <option value="QUAIL">Przepiórka (17 dni)</option>
          <option value="GUINEA">Perliczka (26 dni)</option>
          <option value="PHEASANT">Bażant (24 dni)</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div style="overflow-x:auto;max-height:500px;overflow-y:auto;">
        <table class="sched-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Dzień</th><th>Temp °C</th><th>Wilg %</th><th>Obrót</th><th>Lockdown</th><th>Uwagi</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody id="sched-body1"><tr><td colspan="6" style="color:var(--muted);text-align:center;padding:20px;">Ładowanie...</td></tr></tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ══════════════════ WIRING ════════════════════ -->
<div id="view-wiring" class="view main">
  <div class="section-label">Mapa GPIO i komponenty</div>
  <div class="grid-2">

    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-header"><div class="card-title">Połączenia GPIO</div></div>
      <table class="wire-table">
        <thead><tr><th>Funkcja</th><th>GPIO</th><th>Uwagi</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td class="wire-section" colspan="3">Czujniki temperatury</td></tr>
          <tr><td>DS18B20 #1 Komora jaj<small>1-Wire</small></td><td><code>GPIO 6</code></td><td>Pull-up 4,7kΩ na linii</td></tr>
          <tr><td>DS18B20 #2 Akwarium<small>1-Wire</small></td><td><code>GPIO 6</code></td><td>Wspólna magistrala</td></tr>
          <tr><td class="wire-section" colspan="3">Czujnik wilgotności</td></tr>
          <tr><td>DHT11<small>Single-wire</small></td><td><code>GPIO 8</code></td><td>Pull-up 10kΩ</td></tr>
          <tr><td class="wire-section" colspan="3">Grzałki PWM</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Grzałka CH0<small>PWM out</small></td><td><code>GPIO 1</code></td><td>MOSFET + 100Ω brama</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Grzałka CH1<small>PWM out</small></td><td><code>GPIO 2</code></td><td>MOSFET + 100Ω brama</td></tr>
          <tr><td class="wire-section" colspan="3">Silniki tac</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Taca 1<small>Wyjście sterujące</small></td><td><code>GPIO 18</code></td><td>MOSFET + 100Ω</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Taca 2<small>Wyjście sterujące</small></td><td><code>GPIO 19</code></td><td>MOSFET + 100Ω</td></tr>
          <tr><td class="wire-section" colspan="3">Nawilżanie i wentylacja</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Dyfuzor 2PH63091A</td><td><code>GPIO 21</code></td><td>Dioda flyback 1N4007</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Wentylator</td><td><code>GPIO 7</code></td><td>Wyjście systemowe</td></tr>
          <tr><td class="wire-section" colspan="3">Czujnik ciśnienia I2C</td></tr>
          <tr><td>BMP180 SDA</td><td><code>GPIO 4</code></td><td>Pull-up 4,7kΩ</td></tr>
          <tr><td>BMP180 SCL</td><td><code>GPIO 5</code></td><td>Pull-up 4,7kΩ</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>

    <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;">
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-header"><div class="card-title">Rezystory</div></div>
        <table class="wire-table">
          <thead><tr><th>Miejsce</th><th>Wartość</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            <tr><td>DS18B20 DATA ↔ VCC</td><td><code>4,7 kΩ</code></td></tr>
            <tr><td>DHT11 DATA ↔ VCC</td><td><code>10 kΩ</code></td></tr>
            <tr><td>BMP180 SDA/SCL ↔ VCC</td><td><code>4,7 kΩ</code></td></tr>
            <tr><td>GPIO → brama MOSFET</td><td><code>100 Ω</code></td></tr>
            <tr><td>Brama MOSFET ↔ GND</td><td><code>10 kΩ</code></td></tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-header"><div class="card-title">Kondensatory i diody</div></div>
        <table class="wire-table">
          <thead><tr><th>Linia</th><th>Wartość</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            <tr><td>12V zasilacz (el.)</td><td><code>1000µF / 25V</code></td></tr>
            <tr><td>12V zasilacz (ceram.)</td><td><code>100nF</code></td></tr>
            <tr><td>3,3V ESP (el.)</td><td><code>10µF / 10V</code></td></tr>
            <tr><td>3,3V ESP (ceram.)</td><td><code>100nF</code></td></tr>
            <tr><td>Cewka przekaźnika</td><td><code>1N4007</code> flyback</td></tr>
            <tr><td>MOSFET grzałki</td><td><code>1N5822</code> opcja</td></tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-header"><div class="card-title">Bezpieczniki</div></div>
        <table class="wire-table">
          <thead><tr><th>Linia</th><th>Wartość</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            <tr><td>12V główna (≤50W)</td><td><code>5A</code> topikowy</td></tr>
            <tr><td>12V główna (≤100W)</td><td><code>10A</code> topikowy</td></tr>
            <tr><td>Per kanał grzałki</td><td><code>3A</code> opcja</td></tr>
            <tr><td>5V wentylator/dyfuzor</td><td><code>1A</code> PTC</td></tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ══════════════════ SYSTEM ESP ════════════════ -->
<div id="view-system" class="view main">
  <div class="section-label">Metryki ESP32</div>
  <div class="grid-2">
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-header"><div class="card-title">Pamięć RAM</div></div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">Wolna RAM</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-free">--</span></div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">Użyta RAM</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-used">--</span></div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">Całość RAM</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-total">--</span></div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">PSRAM wolna</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-psram">--</span></div>
      <div class="gauge-wrap" style="margin-top:10px;">
        <div class="gauge-track">
          <div class="gauge-fill memory" id="gauge-ram" style="width:0%"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="gauge-labels"><span>0%</span><span>RAM</span><span>100%</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-header"><div class="card-title">Procesor i wersje</div></div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">Temp. wewnętrzna</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-temp">--</span></div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">CPU</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-cpu">--</span></div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">Rdzenie</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-cores">--</span></div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">Wersja config</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-cfgver">--</span></div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">Tryb testowy</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-testmode">--</span></div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">Uptime</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-uptime">--</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="section-label" style="margin-top:20px;">Export danych sesji</div>
  <div class="grid-auto">
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-header"><div class="card-title">Historia pomiarów (sesja)</div></div>
      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:10px;">Zapisano <span id="hist-count">0</span> pomiarów od startu strony</div>
      <div class="btn-group">
        <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="exportCSV()">Pobierz CSV</button>
        <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="clearHistory()">Wyczyść historię</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
// ═══════════════ STATE ════════════════
const state = {
  tray: [{day:1,species:'CHICKEN'},{day:1,species:'CHICKEN'}],
  heater: [{pwm:0,manual:false},{pwm:0,manual:false}],
  diffuser: {on:false,manual:false},
  api: false
};

// Temperature history for sparklines (last 30 samples each)
const hist = { temp0:[], temp1:[], hum:[] };
const MAX_HIST = 50;

// ═══════════════ TABS ════════════════
function showTab(name) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach((t,i)=>{
    const names=['panel','heaters','trays','schedule','wiring','system'];
    t.classList.toggle('active', names[i]===name);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v=>{
    v.classList.toggle('active', v.id==='view-'+name);
  });
  if(name==='schedule'){loadSchedule(0);loadSchedule(1);}
}

// ═══════════════ API FETCH ════════════════
let fetching = false;
let abortCtrl = null;

async function fetchData() {
  if(fetching) return;
  fetching = true;
  if(abortCtrl) abortCtrl.abort();
  abortCtrl = new AbortController();
  const sig = abortCtrl.signal;
  try {
    const [sRes, tRes] = await Promise.all([
      fetch('/api/status', {signal:sig}),
      fetch('/api/trays',  {signal:sig})
    ]);
    const s = await sRes.json();
    const t = await tRes.json();
    updateAll(s, t);
  } catch(e) {
    if(e.name!=='AbortError') setApiStatus(false);
  } finally { fetching=false; }
}

function setApiStatus(ok) {
  const dot = document.getElementById('apiDot');
  const txt = document.getElementById('apiStatusTop');
  dot.className = 'dot '+(ok?'ok':'err');
  txt.textContent = ok ? 'OK' : 'BRAK';
  state.api = ok;
}

// ═══════════════ UPDATE ALL ════════════════
function updateAll(s, t) {
  setApiStatus(true);

  // ── Uptime
  const ms = s.uptime_ms||0;
  const h=Math.floor(ms/3600000), m=Math.floor((ms%3600000)/60000), sec=Math.floor((ms%60000)/1000);
  const uStr = [h,m,sec].map(x=>String(x).padStart(2,'0')).join(':');
  setText('uptimeTop', uStr);
  setText('esp-uptime', uStr);

  // ── Temperatures
  const t0 = s.temp_chamber, t1 = s.temp_aquarium, tgt = s.target_temp;
  setTemp('disp-temp0', 'card-temp0', 'gauge-temp0', t0, tgt, 30, 42);
  setTemp('disp-temp1', 'card-temp1', 'gauge-temp1', t1, tgt, 30, 42);
  setText('disp-target', isF(tgt)?tgt.toFixed(1)+' °C':'--');
  if(isF(t0)&&isF(tgt)) setMarker('marker-target', tgt, 30, 42);

  // History
  if(isF(t0)){ hist.temp0.push({v:t0,ts:Date.now()}); if(hist.temp0.length>MAX_HIST)hist.temp0.shift(); }
  if(isF(t1)){ hist.temp1.push({v:t1,ts:Date.now()}); if(hist.temp1.length>MAX_HIST)hist.temp1.shift(); }

  // ── Humidity
  const hum=s.humidity, hMin=s.humidity_target_min||45, hMax=s.humidity_target_max||65;
  if(isF(hum)) { hist.hum.push({v:hum,ts:Date.now()}); if(hist.hum.length>MAX_HIST)hist.hum.shift(); }
  setText('disp-hum', isF(hum)?hum.toFixed(1):'--');
  setText('disp-hum-range', hMin+'–'+hMax+' %');
  if(isF(hum)){
    const pct = Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(hum-30)/60*100));
    setGauge('gauge-hum', pct, null);
    setMarker('marker-hum-min', hMin, 30, 90);
    setMarker('marker-hum-max', hMax, 30, 90);
  }
  drawSpark('spark-hum', hist.hum, 30, 90, '#38bdf8');

  drawSpark('spark-temp0', hist.temp0, 34, 40, '#f97316');
  drawSpark('spark-temp1', hist.temp1, 34, 40, '#f97316');

  // ── Heaters (support separate ch0/ch1 OR fallback to heater_pwm)
  const pwm0 = isF(s.heater_pwm_ch0) ? s.heater_pwm_ch0 : (isF(s.heater_pwm)?s.heater_pwm:0);
  const pwm1 = isF(s.heater_pwm_ch1) ? s.heater_pwm_ch1 : (isF(s.heater_pwm)?s.heater_pwm:0);
  const man0 = !!(s.heater_manual_ch0 ?? s.heater_manual_mode ?? false);
  const man1 = !!(s.heater_manual_ch1 ?? s.heater_manual_mode ?? false);

  updateHeater(0, pwm0, man0);
  updateHeater(1, pwm1, man1);

  // ── Trays
  const traysData = t.trays || [];
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
    const tr = traysData[i]||{};
    updateTrayUI(i, tr, s);
  }

  // ── Diffuser
  const diffOn = !!s.diffuser_on, diffMan = !!s.diffuser_manual_mode;
  updateDiffuserUI(diffOn, diffMan);

  // ── ESP metrics
  if(s.esp_free_heap!=null){
    const freeKB=(s.esp_free_heap/1024).toFixed(0);
    const totalKB=((s.esp_total_heap||0)/1024).toFixed(0);
    const usedKB=(((s.esp_total_heap||0)-s.esp_free_heap)/1024).toFixed(0);
    const ramPct = s.esp_total_heap ? Math.round((1 - s.esp_free_heap/s.esp_total_heap)*100) : 0;
    setTextCls('esp-free', freeKB+' KB', s.esp_free_heap<20480?'danger':'');
    setText('esp-used', usedKB+' KB');
    setText('esp-total', totalKB+' KB');
    setText('esp-psram', s.esp_free_psram!=null?(s.esp_free_psram/1024).toFixed(0)+' KB':'N/A');
    setGauge('gauge-ram', ramPct, null);
  }
  if(s.esp_internal_temp!=null) setText('esp-temp', s.esp_internal_temp.toFixed(1)+' °C');
  if(s.esp_cpu_freq_mhz!=null) setText('esp-cpu', s.esp_cpu_freq_mhz+' MHz');
  if(s.esp_chip_cores!=null)   setText('esp-cores', s.esp_chip_cores);
  setText('esp-cfgver',   s.config_version||'--');
  setText('esp-testmode', s.test_mode?'TAK':'NIE');

  // ── History count
  setText('hist-count', hist.temp0.length);

  // ── Top badges
  updateTopBadges(s, traysData);
}

function updateHeater(ch, pwm, manual) {
  state.heater[ch] = {pwm, manual};
  const ids = ['disp-pwm'+ch,'disp2-pwm'+ch];
  const gids = ['gauge-pwm'+ch,'gauge2-pwm'+ch];
  const pids = ['pill-h'+ch,'pill2-h'+ch];
  ids.forEach(id=>{ const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el)el.innerHTML=(isF(pwm)?pwm.toFixed(0):'--')+'<span class="metric-unit">%</span>'; });
  gids.forEach(id=>setGauge(id, pwm, null));
  pids.forEach(id=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(id); if(!el)return;
    el.textContent=manual?'RĘCZNY':'AUTO';
    el.className='mode-pill '+(manual?'manual':'auto');
  });
  if(!manual){
    const sl=document.getElementById('sl-h'+ch);
    if(sl) { sl.value=pwm; document.getElementById('sv-h'+ch).textContent=Math.round(pwm)+'%'; }
  }
}

function updateTrayUI(i, tr, s) {
  const active = !!tr.active, moving = !!tr.moving;
  const dayKey = i===0 ? (s.current_day||1) : (s.current_day_tray1||s.current_day||1);
  state.tray[i].day = dayKey;

  // indicator
  ['ind-tray'+i,'ind3-tray'+i].forEach(id=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(id); if(!el)return;
    el.className=(el.className.split(' ')[0])+(moving?' moving':active?' on':'');
  });
  ['txt-tray'+i].forEach(id=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(id); if(!el)return;
    el.textContent=moving?'OBRÓT':active?'ON':'STOP';
    el.className='tray-status-text '+(active?'on':'off');
  });
  ['det-tray'+i].forEach(id=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(id); if(!el)return;
    el.textContent='Ostatni obrót: '+fmtRot(tr);
  });
  ['disp-day'+i].forEach(id=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(id); if(!el)return;
    el.textContent='Dzień '+dayKey;
  });

  // species badge
  const sp = document.getElementById('species-tray'+i);
  const spBadge = document.getElementById('badge-tray'+i+'-species');
  if(spBadge && sp) spBadge.textContent = shortSpecies(sp.value);

  // lockdown badge in topbar is handled by updateTopBadges
}

function updateDiffuserUI(on, manual) {
  ['ind-diff','ind2-diff'].forEach(id=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(id); if(!el)return;
    el.className='tray-indicator'+(on?' on':'');
  });
  ['txt-diff'].forEach(id=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(id); if(!el)return;
    el.textContent=on?'PRACUJE':'STOP';
    el.className='tray-status-text '+(on?'on':'off');
  });
  ['txt2-diff'].forEach(id=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(id); if(!el)return;
    el.textContent=on?'PRACUJE':'STOP';
  });
  ['pill-diff','pill3-diff'].forEach(id=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(id); if(!el)return;
    el.textContent=manual?'RĘCZNY':'AUTO';
    el.className='mode-pill '+(manual?'manual':'auto');
  });
}

function updateTopBadges(s, traysData) {
  const badges = [];
  const t0=s.temp_chamber, tgt=s.target_temp;
  if(isF(t0)&&isF(tgt)){
    const diff=Math.abs(t0-tgt);
    if(diff>1) badges.push(`<span class="badge badge-warn">TEMP ±${diff.toFixed(1)}°C</span>`);
    if(t0>40.5) badges.push(`<span class="badge badge-hot">PRZEGRZANIE</span>`);
  }
  if(s.diffuser_on) badges.push(`<span class="badge badge-info">DYFUZOR ON</span>`);
  if(s.test_mode) badges.push(`<span class="badge badge-warn">TEST MODE</span>`);

  // Lockdown check
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
    const sp = (document.getElementById('species-tray'+i)||{}).value||'CHICKEN';
    const day = state.tray[i].day;
    const dur = SPECIES[sp]||SPECIES.CHICKEN;
    if(day >= dur.lockdown) badges.push(`<span class="badge badge-lock">LOCKDOWN T${i+1}</span>`);
  }

  document.getElementById('topbarBadges').innerHTML = badges.join('');
}

// ═══════════════ SPARKLINE CANVAS ════════════════
function drawSpark(id, data, minV, maxV, color) {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  if(!el||data.length<2) return;
  const W=el.width=el.offsetWidth||260, H=el.height=40;
  const ctx=el.getContext('2d');
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  const range=maxV-minV||1;
  const pts=data.slice(-30);
  ctx.beginPath();
  pts.forEach((p,i)=>{
    const x=i/(pts.length-1)*W;
    const y=H-(p.v-minV)/range*H;
    i===0?ctx.moveTo(x,y):ctx.lineTo(x,y);
  });
  ctx.strokeStyle=color;
  ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
  ctx.stroke();
  // fill under
  ctx.lineTo(W,H); ctx.lineTo(0,H); ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle=color+'22';
  ctx.fill();
}

// ═══════════════ HELPERS ════════════════
function isF(v){ return Number.isFinite(v)&&v>-100; }
function setText(id,v){ const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el)el.textContent=v; }
function setTextCls(id,v,cls){ const el=document.getElementById(id); if(!el)return; el.textContent=v; el.className='esp-val '+(cls||''); }

function setTemp(dispId, cardId, gaugeId, val, tgt, lo, hi) {
  const el=document.getElementById(dispId);
  if(!el) return;
  el.innerHTML=(isF(val)?val.toFixed(1):'--')+'<span class="metric-unit">°C</span>';
  let cls='';
  if(isF(val)&&isF(tgt)){
    if(val>tgt+1) cls='hot'; else if(val>tgt+0.3) cls='warn'; else if(val<tgt-1) cls='cool'; else cls='ok';
  }
  el.className='metric-big '+(cls||'');
  const card=document.getElementById(cardId);
  if(card){ card.classList.toggle('alarm', cls==='hot'); card.classList.toggle('alarm-flash', cls==='hot'); }
  if(isF(val)) setGauge(gaugeId, Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(val-lo)/(hi-lo)*100)), cls);
}

function setGauge(id, pct, cls) {
  const el=document.getElementById(id);
  if(!el)return;
  el.style.width=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,pct))+'%';
}

function setMarker(id, val, lo, hi) {
  const el=document.getElementById(id);
  if(!el)return;
  el.style.left=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(val-lo)/(hi-lo)*100))+'%';
}

function fmtRot(tray) {
  if(!tray||!tray.has_last_rotation) return 'brak';
  const h=String(tray.last_rotation_hour||0).padStart(2,'0');
  const m=String(tray.last_rotation_minute||0).padStart(2,'0');
  return `Dzień ${tray.last_rotation_day||0}, ${h}:${m}`;
}

function shortSpecies(v) {
  return {CHICKEN:'Kura',DUCK:'Kaczka',GOOSE:'Gęś',QUAIL:'Przepiórka',GUINEA:'Perliczka',PHEASANT:'Bażant'}[v]||v;
}

function updateSpeciesBadge(i) {
  const sp = document.getElementById('species-tray'+i);
  const b = document.getElementById('badge-tray'+i+'-species');
  if(b&&sp) b.textContent=shortSpecies(sp.value);
}

// ═══════════════ TRAY ACTIONS ════════════════
async function moveTray(i) {
  const btn=document.getElementById('movebtn-'+i);
  const st=document.getElementById('st-move'+i);
  const dur=parseInt(document.getElementById('dur-tray'+i).value,10);
  const spd=document.getElementById('spd-tray'+i).value;
  if(btn) btn.disabled=true;
  setMsg(st,'info','⏳ Wysyłanie…');
  try {
    const r=await fetch('/api/tray/move?tray='+i+'&duration_ms='+dur+'&pwm_speed='+spd,{method:'POST'});
    const d=await r.json();
    if(d.ok) setMsg(st,'ok','✓ Ruch uruchomiony ('+dur+' ms)');
    else setMsg(st,'err','✗ '+(d.error||'Błąd'));
  } catch(e){ setMsg(st,'err','✗ Brak połączenia'); }
  setTimeout(()=>{ if(btn)btn.disabled=false; },2500);
}

async function setTrayDay(i) {
  const day=parseInt(document.getElementById('day-tray'+i).value,10);
  const st=document.getElementById('st-day'+i);
  if(!Number.isFinite(day)||day<1||day>40){ setMsg(st,'err','✗ Dzień 1–40'); return; }
  setMsg(st,'info','⏳ Ustawianie…');
  try {
    const r=await fetch('/api/tray/set-day?tray='+i+'&day='+day,{method:'POST'});
    const d=await r.json();
    if(d.ok){ setMsg(st,'ok','✓ Dzień '+day+' ustawiony'); state.tray[i].day=day; }
    else setMsg(st,'err','✗ '+(d.error||'Błąd'));
  } catch(e){ setMsg(st,'err','✗ Brak połączenia'); }
}

// ═══════════════ HEATER ACTIONS ════════════════
async function setHeaterManual(ch) {
  const pct=document.getElementById('sl-h'+ch).value;
  const st=document.getElementById('st-h'+ch);
  setMsg(st,'info','⏳ Wysyłanie…');
  try {
    const url='/api/heater/set?ch='+ch+'&pct='+pct;
    const r=await fetch(url,{method:'POST'});
    const d=await r.json();
    if(d.ok) setMsg(st,'ok','✓ CH'+ch+' PWM: '+pct+'%');
    else setMsg(st,'err','✗ '+(d.error||'Błąd'));
  } catch(e){ setMsg(st,'err','✗ Brak połączenia'); }
}

async function setHeaterAuto(ch) {
  const st=document.getElementById('st-h'+ch);
  setMsg(st,'info','⏳ Wysyłanie…');
  try {
    const r=await fetch('/api/heater/set?ch='+ch+'&auto=1',{method:'POST'});
    const d=await r.json();
    if(d.ok) setMsg(st,'ok','✓ CH'+ch+' → AUTO');
    else setMsg(st,'err','✗ '+(d.error||'Błąd'));
  } catch(e){ setMsg(st,'err','✗ Brak połączenia'); }
}

// ═══════════════ DIFFUSER ACTIONS ════════════════
async function setDiffuser(on) {
  const sts=['st-diff','st2-diff'];
  sts.forEach(id=>setMsg(document.getElementById(id),'info','⏳ Wysyłanie…'));
  try {
    const r=await fetch('/api/diffuser/set?on='+on,{method:'POST'});
    const d=await r.json();
    const msg=d.ok?'✓ Dyfuzor '+(on?'ON':'OFF'):'✗ '+(d.error||'Błąd');
    sts.forEach(id=>setMsg(document.getElementById(id),d.ok?'ok':'err',msg));
  } catch(e){ sts.forEach(id=>setMsg(document.getElementById(id),'err','✗ Brak połączenia')); }
}

async function setDiffuserAuto() {
  const sts=['st-diff','st2-diff'];
  try {
    const r=await fetch('/api/diffuser/set?auto=1',{method:'POST'});
    const d=await r.json();
    const msg=d.ok?'✓ Dyfuzor → AUTO':'✗ '+(d.error||'Błąd');
    sts.forEach(id=>setMsg(document.getElementById(id),d.ok?'ok':'err',msg));
  } catch(e){ sts.forEach(id=>setMsg(document.getElementById(id),'err','✗ Brak połączenia')); }
}

function setMsg(el,type,text){
  if(!el)return;
  el.textContent=text;
  el.className='status-msg '+(type||'');
}

// ═══════════════ SCHEDULE DATA ════════════════
const SPECIES = {
  CHICKEN: { days:21, lockdown:19, name:'Kura',
    rows: d=>({
      temp_min:d<18?37.5:37.2, temp_max:d<18?37.8:37.5,

      note: d===1?'Start inkubacji': d===7?'Kandelowanie (1)': d===14?'Kandelowanie (2)': d===18?'Ostatni obrót': d===19?'LOCKDOWN – bez obrotów': d===21?'Wyklucie':'',
    })
  },
  DUCK: { days:28, lockdown:25, name:'Kaczka',

    })
  },
  GOOSE: { days:30, lockdown:27, name:'Gęś',
    rows: d=>({

      note: d===1?'Start': d===7?'Kandelowanie': d===14?'Kandelowanie': d===26?'Ostatni obrót': d===27?'LOCKDOWN': d===30?'Wyklucie':'',
    })
  },
  QUAIL: { days:17, lockdown:15, name:'Przepiórka',
    rows: d=>({

      hum_min:d<15?45:65, hum_max:d<15?55:75,

    })

    rows: d=>({

      note: d===1?'Start': d===7?'Kandelowanie': d===20?'Ostatni obrót': d===21?'LOCKDOWN': d===24?'Wyklucie':'',
    })

};

async function loadSchedule(trayIdx) {
  const selId='sched-species'+trayIdx;
  const bodyId='sched-body'+trayIdx;
  const sp=document.getElementById(selId);
  if(!sp)return;
  const species=sp.value;
  const tbody=document.getElementById(bodyId);
  if(!tbody)return;

  const currentDay = state.tray[trayIdx].day||1;
  const spData=SPECIES[species]||SPECIES.CHICKEN;

  let html='';
  // Try API first, fallback to local data
  let rows=null;
  try {
    const r=await fetch('/api/schedule?species='+species);
    const d=await r.json();
    if(d.schedule&&d.schedule.length) rows=d.schedule;
  } catch(e){}

  if(!rows){
    rows=[];
    for(let d=1;d<=spData.days;d++){
      const r=spData.rows(d);
      rows.push({day:d,temp_min:r.temp_min,temp_max:r.temp_max,humidity_min:r.hum_min,humidity_max:r.hum_max,turn:r.turn,lockdown:r.lockdown,notes:r.note});
    }
  }

  html=rows.map(row=>{
    const isToday=(row.day===currentDay);
    const cls=isToday?'today':row.lockdown?'lockdown':'';
    const dayLabel=isToday?`<span class="day-num today-tag">▶ ${row.day}</span>`:`<span class="day-num">${row.day}</span>`;
    const turnIcon=row.turn?'<span class="check">✓</span>':'<span class="cross">—</span>';
    const lockIcon=row.lockdown?'<span class="lock-badge">LOCK</span>':'';
    const note=row.notes||'';
    return `<tr class="${cls}"><td>${dayLabel}</td><td>${row.temp_min.toFixed(1)}–${row.temp_max.toFixed(1)}</td><td>${row.humidity_min}–${row.humidity_max}</td><td>${turnIcon}</td><td>${lockIcon}</td><td style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);">${note}</td></tr>`;
  }).join('');
  tbody.innerHTML=html||'<tr><td colspan="6" style="color:var(--muted);text-align:center;padding:16px;">Brak danych</td></tr>';
}

// ═══════════════ CSV EXPORT ════════════════
function exportCSV() {
  const rows=[['timestamp','temp_chamber','temp_aquarium','humidity']];
  const n=Math.max(hist.temp0.length,hist.temp1.length,hist.hum.length);
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const t0=hist.temp0[i], t1=hist.temp1[i], h=hist.hum[i];
    const ts=t0?.ts||t1?.ts||h?.ts||Date.now();
    rows.push([new Date(ts).toISOString(), t0?.v??'', t1?.v??'', h?.v??'']);
  }
  const csv=rows.map(r=>r.join(',')).join('\n');
  const a=document.createElement('a');
  a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv],{type:'text/csv'}));
  a.download='inkubator_'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,19).replace(/:/g,'-')+'.csv';
  a.click();
}

function clearHistory() {
  hist.temp0.length=0; hist.temp1.length=0; hist.hum.length=0;
  setText('hist-count','0');
}

// ═══════════════ INIT ════════════════
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{
  if(!document.hidden) fetchData();
});

fetchData();
const interval = setInterval(fetchData, 3000);

// Initial schedule load attempt after 500ms
setTimeout(()=>{ if(document.getElementById('view-schedule').classList.contains('active')){ loadSchedule(0); loadSchedule(1); } }, 500);
</script>
</body>
</html>

```
<script>
const state={tray:[{day:1,species:'CHICKEN'},{day:1,species:'CHICKEN'}],api:false};
const hist={temp0:[],temp1:[],hum:[]}; const MAX_HIST=50; let fetching=false; let abortCtrl=null;
const SPECIES={CHICKEN:{days:21,lockdown:19,rows:d=>({tmin:d<18?37.5:37.2,tmax:d<18?37.8:37.5,hmin:d<19?45:65,hmax:d<19?55:75,turn:d<19,lockdown:d>=19,note:d===18?'Ostatni obrót':d===19?'LOCKDOWN – bez obrotów':''})},DUCK:{days:28,lockdown:25,rows:d=>({tmin:d<25?37.5:37.2,tmax:d<25?37.8:37.5,hmin:d<25?55:70,hmax:d<25?65:80,turn:d<25,lockdown:d>=25,note:d===24?'Ostatni obrót':d===25?'LOCKDOWN':''})},GOOSE:{days:30,lockdown:27,rows:d=>({tmin:d<27?37.4:37.2,tmax:d<27?37.8:37.5,hmin:d<27?55:70,hmax:d<27?65:80,turn:d<27,lockdown:d>=27,note:d===26?'Ostatni obrót':d===27?'LOCKDOWN':''})},QUAIL:{days:17,lockdown:15,rows:d=>({tmin:d<15?37.6:37.3,tmax:d<15?37.9:37.6,hmin:d<15?45:65,hmax:d<15?55:75,turn:d<15,lockdown:d>=15,note:d===14?'Ostatni obrót':d===15?'LOCKDOWN':''})},GUINEA:{days:26,lockdown:23,rows:d=>({tmin:d<23?37.5:37.2,tmax:d<23?37.8:37.5,hmin:d<23?50:65,hmax:d<23?60:75,turn:d<23,lockdown:d>=23,note:d===22?'Ostatni obrót':d===23?'LOCKDOWN':''})},PHEASANT:{days:24,lockdown:21,rows:d=>({tmin:d<21?37.5:37.2,tmax:d<21?37.8:37.5,hmin:d<21?50:65,hmax:d<21?60:75,turn:d<21,lockdown:d>=21,note:d===20?'Ostatni obrót':d===21?'LOCKDOWN':''})}};
function isF(v){return Number.isFinite(v)&&v>-100}
function setText(id,v){const e=document.getElementById(id); if(e)e.textContent=v}
function setMsg(el,type,text){if(!el)return; el.textContent=text; el.className='status-msg '+(type||'')}
function showTab(name){document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach((t,i)=>{const names=['panel','heaters','trays','schedule','wiring','system']; t.classList.toggle('active',names[i]===name);}); document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v=>v.classList.toggle('active',v.id==='view-'+name)); if(name==='schedule'){loadSchedule(0);loadSchedule(1);}}
let fetching=false; let abortCtrl=null;
async function fetchData(){ if(fetching)return; fetching=true; if(abortCtrl)abortCtrl.abort(); abortCtrl=new AbortController(); const sig=abortCtrl.signal; try{ const [sRes,tRes]=await Promise.all([fetch('/api/status',{signal:sig}),fetch('/api/trays',{signal:sig})]); const s=await sRes.json(), t=await tRes.json(); updateAll(s,t); } catch(e){ if(e.name!=='AbortError') setApiStatus(false); } finally{fetching=false;} }
function setApiStatus(ok){const dot=document.getElementById('apiDot'),txt=document.getElementById('apiStatusTop'); dot.className='dot '+(ok?'ok':'err'); txt.textContent=ok?'OK':'BRAK'; state.api=ok;}
function updateAll(s,t){ setApiStatus(true); const ms=s.uptime_ms||0; const hh=Math.floor(ms/3600000), mm=Math.floor((ms%3600000)/60000), ss=Math.floor((ms%60000)/1000); const up=[hh,mm,ss].map(v=>String(v).padStart(2,'0')).join(':'); setText('uptimeTop',up); setText('esp-uptime',up); const t0=s.temp_chamber,t1=s.temp_aquarium,tgt=s.target_temp; setTemp('disp-temp0','card-temp0','gauge-temp0',t0,tgt,30,42); setTemp('disp-temp1','card-temp1','gauge-temp1',t1,tgt,30,42); setText('disp-target',isF(tgt)?tgt.toFixed(1)+' °C':'--'); if(isF(tgt)) setMarker('marker-target',tgt,30,42); if(isF(t0)) hist.temp0.push({v:t0,ts:Date.now()}); if(isF(t1)) hist.temp1.push({v:t1,ts:Date.now()}); if(hist.temp0.length>MAX_HIST)hist.temp0.shift(); if(hist.temp1.length>MAX_HIST)hist.temp1.shift(); const hum=s.humidity,hMin=s.humidity_target_min||45,hMax=s.humidity_target_max||65; if(isF(hum)) hist.hum.push({v:hum,ts:Date.now()}); if(hist.hum.length>MAX_HIST)hist.hum.shift(); setText('disp-hum',isF(hum)?hum.toFixed(1):'--'); setText('disp-hum-range',hMin+'–'+hMax+' %'); if(isF(hum)){ setGauge('gauge-hum',Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(hum-30)/60*100))); setText('disp-target',isF(tgt)?tgt.toFixed(1)+' °C':'--'); if(isF(tgt)) setMarker('marker-target',tgt,30,42); if(isF(t0)) hist.temp0.push({v:t0,ts:Date.now()}); if(isF(t1)) hist.temp1.push({v:t1,ts:Date.now()}); if(hist.hum.length>MAX_HIST)hist.hum.shift(); setText('disp-hum',isF(hum)?hum.toFixed(1):'--'); setText('disp-hum-range',hMin+'–'+hMax+' %'); if(isF(hum)){ setGauge('gauge-hum',Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(hum-30)/60*100))); setMarker('marker-hum-min',hMin,30,90); setMarker('marker-hum-max',hMax,30,90);} drawSpark('spark-hum',hist.hum,30,90,'#38bdf8'); drawSpark('spark-temp0',hist.temp0,34,40,'#f97316'); drawSpark('spark-temp1',hist.temp1,34,40,'#f97316'); const pwm0=isF(s.heater_pwm_ch0)?s.heater_pwm_ch0:(isF(s.heater_pwm)?s.heater_pwm:0), pwm1=isF(s.heater_pwm_ch1)?s.heater_pwm_ch1:(isF(s.heater_pwm)?s.heater_pwm:0); updateHeater(0,pwm0,!!s.heater_manual_ch0); updateHeater(1,pwm1,!!s.heater_manual_ch1); const trays=t.trays||[]; for(let i=0;i<2;i++) updateTrayUI(i,trays[i]||{},s); updateDiffuserUI(!!s.diffuser_on,!!s.diffuser_manual_mode); if(s.esp_free_heap!=null){ const freeKB=(s.esp_free_heap/1024).toFixed(0), totalKB=((s.esp_total_heap||0)/1024).toFixed(0), usedKB=(((s.esp_total_heap||0)-s.esp_free_heap)/1024).toFixed(0), ramPct=s.esp_total_heap?Math.round((1-s.esp_free_heap/s.esp_total_heap)*100):0; ```js
```
```js
function updateTopESP(s) {
  const temp = s.esp_internal_temp;
  const el = document.getElementById('espTempTop');
  const dot = document.getElementById('espDot');
  
  if (temp != null) {
    el.textContent = temp.toFixed(1) + '°C';
    if (temp > 65) {
      el.style.color = 'var(--hot)';
      dot.className = 'dot err';
    } else if (temp > 55) {
      el.style.color = 'var(--yellow)';
      dot.className = 'dot warn'; // dodaj .dot.warn {background: var(--yellow)}
    } else {
      el.style.color = '';
      dot.className = 'dot ok';
    }
  }
}
```

 ## Uwagi
 
 - LM2596 **nastawić na 5V** przed podłączeniem ESP32 (potencjometr na module).
 - ESP32-S3 zasilany z 5V (pin 5V/VBUS) lub 3.3V z przetwornicy.
 - MOSFET-y sterowane sygnałem PWM z GPIO ESP32 (3.3V logika - sprawdzić próg bramki gate driver).
 - Grzałki 12V podłączone przez drain/source MOSFET, masa wspólna z zasilaczem.
+
+---
+
+## Aktualizacja 2026-05-17
+
+### WebUI
+- Główny panel działa jako jeden spójny widok z osobnymi zakładkami:
+  - Panel
+  - Harmonogram
+  - Połączenia i ESP
+  - Okablowanie i zabezpieczenia
+- W zakładce okablowania dodano tabelę elementów ochronnych (rezystory, bezpieczniki, diody) i checklistę serwisową.
+
+### Kondensatory (czujniki i linie sygnałowe)
+- DS18B20: 100nF między VDD i GND przy każdym czujniku.
+- DHT22: 100nF + 1uF przy zasilaniu czujnika.
+- BMP180 (I2C): 100nF między 3V3 i GND przy module.
+- Linie sygnałowe dłuższe niż ~30 cm: opcjonalnie 1nF-4.7nF do GND przy wejściu MCU (tylko gdy występują zakłócenia).
+- Pull-upy sygnałów czujników prowadzić do 3V3 (nie do 5V), żeby chronić GPIO ESP32-S3.
+
+### Konfiguracja runtime
+- Aktualny plik konfiguracyjny urządzenia: firmware/data/config.json
+- Obecnie używane kluczowe parametry:

+  - dht22_pin: 8
+  - bmp180_enabled: true (SDA GPIO4, SCL GPIO5)
+  - heater_pin_1: 1, heater_pin_2: 2
+  - diffuser pin: 21

 | Pin | Funkcja | Typ | Przeznaczenie | Uwagi |

-| 7 | GPIO7 | OneWire | Czujnik DS18B20 #2 (opcja) | + Pull-up 4.7kΩ do +5V |
+| 6 | GPIO6 | OneWire | Czujnik DS18B20 #1 | + Pull-up 4.7kΩ do +3.3V |
+| 7 | GPIO7 | OneWire | Czujnik DS18B20 #2 (opcja) | + Pull-up 4.7kΩ do +3.3V |
@@
 ### Czujnik wilgoci (DHT22 - DHT protocol)
 | Pin | Funkcja | Typ | Przeznaczenie | Uwagi |
 |-----|---------|-----|---------------|-------|
-| 8 | GPIO8 | DHT | DHT22 signal pin | + Pull-up 10kΩ do +5V |
+| 8 | GPIO8 | DHT | DHT22 signal pin | + Pull-up 10kΩ do +3.3V |
@@
 ### Czujniki temperatury (DS18B20 - OneWire)
 ```
-+5V ─────[4.7kΩ Pull-up]─────┬─────────────────────────┐
++3.3V ────[4.7kΩ Pull-up]─────┬─────────────────────────┐
                               │                         │
                       ┌───────┴──────┐         ┌───────┴──────┐
                       │ DS18B20 #1   │         │ DS18B20 #2   │
                       │              │         │              │
@@
 ### Czujnik wilgoci (DHT22)
 ```
-+5V ─────[10kΩ Pull-up]────────┬────────────┐
++3.3V ────[10kΩ Pull-up]────────┬────────────┐
                                │            │
                       ┌────────┴──────┐     │
                       │ DHT22         │     │
@@

+
+## Kondensatory - czujniki i linie sygnałowe
+
+| Obwód | Kondensator | Miejsce montażu | Cel |
+|------|-------------|-----------------|-----|
+| DS18B20 (każdy czujnik) | 100nF ceramiczny (X7R) | Między VDD i GND, możliwie blisko obudowy czujnika | Odfiltrowanie zakłóceń i stabilny odczyt 1-Wire |
+| DHT22 | 100nF + 1uF | Równolegle między VDD i GND przy module DHT22 | Tłumienie pików prądowych i stabilizacja zasilania |
+| BMP180 (I2C) | 100nF | Między 3.3V i GND przy module | Ograniczenie zakłóceń magistrali I2C |
+| Wejścia GPIO z długą wiązką (>30 cm) | 1nF-4.7nF (opcjonalnie) | Od sygnału do GND przy ESP32 | Redukcja zakłóceń impulsowych (stosować tylko przy realnych problemach) |
+
+### Notatka praktyczna
+- Pull-upy sygnałowe czujników podłączaj do 3.3V, nie do 5V.
+- Przy przewodach czujników prowadzonych obok linii mocy 12V rozważ skrętkę sygnał + GND.
+- Dla sekcji mocy zostaw osobne kondensatory elektrolityczne przy obciążeniach (grzałki, dyfuzor).
+
+---

-   - 10µF film @ sygnałach PWM

JavaScriptfunction updateDiffuserUI(on, manual) {
  const ind = document.getElementById('ind-diff');
  if (ind) ind.className = 'tray-indicator' + (on ? ' on' : '');

  const txt = document.getElementById('txt-diff');
  if (txt) {
    txt.textContent = on ? 'PRACUJE' : 'STOP';
    txt.className = 'tray-status-text ' + (on ? 'on' : 'off');
  }

  const pill = document.getElementById('pill-diff');
  if (pill) {
    pill.textContent = manual ? 'RĘCZNY' : 'AUTO';
    pill.className = 'mode-pill ' + (manual ? 'manual' : 'auto');
  }
}

function updateTrayUI(i, tr) {
  const day = tr.current_day || state.tray[i].day || 1;
  state.tray[i].day = day;

  const summary = document.getElementById('main-tray' + i + '-summary');
  if (summary) summary.textContent = 'Ostatni obrót: ' + fmtRot(tr);

  const badge = document.getElementById('badge-tray' + i + '-species');
  const speciesSel = document.getElementById('main-species-tray' + i);
  if (badge && speciesSel) badge.textContent = shortSpecies(speciesSel.value);
}
2. Poprawiony updateHeater
JavaScriptfunction updateHeater(ch, pwm, manual) {
  const disp = document.getElementById('disp-main-pwm' + ch);
  if (disp) disp.innerHTML = (isF(pwm) ? pwm.toFixed(0) : '--') + '<span class="metric-unit">%</span>';

  const pill = document.getElementById('pill-main-h' + ch);
  if (pill) {
    pill.textContent = manual ? 'RĘCZNY' : 'AUTO';
    pill.className = 'mode-pill ' + (manual ? 'manual' : 'auto');
  }

  const slider = document.getElementById('sl-main-h' + ch);
  if (slider && !manual) {
    slider.value = Math.round(pwm || 0);
    setText('sv-main-h' + ch, Math.round(pwm || 0) + '%');
  }
}
